headlines.title: 法国央行预计第三季度经济保持增长势头
headlines.summary: 法国央行表示，在重点行业增长和通胀降温支撑下，法国经济本季度有望保持增长势头。法国央行周二援引月度企业调查称，预计第三季度GDP将增长0.2%。这将与前一季度持平，略高于彭博调查分析师预计的0.1%。 法国央行表示，经济活动将继续由包括交通运输、信息和通信在内的服务业带动，而制造业在8月出现反弹。展望未来，能源行业预计将扩张，但由于公共合同减少，建筑业可能进一步下滑。与此同时，法国央行警告称，经济仍面临“重大不确定性”，原因包括“中东地缘政治局势以及直至夏末的天气状况，届时仍可能出现新的热浪”。

headlines.title_en: French central bank expects economy to maintain growth momentum in Q3
headlines.summary_en: France's central bank said the economy is expected to sustain its growth momentum this quarter, supported by growth in key sectors and cooling inflation. Citing a monthly business survey, it projected GDP growth of 0.2% in Q3, unchanged from the previous quarter and slightly above the 0.1% forecast by analysts in a Bloomberg survey. Activity will continue to be led by services including transport and information/communications, while manufacturing rebounded in August. Looking ahead, the energy sector is expected to expand, but construction may decline further due to fewer public contracts. The bank warned of "significant uncertainty" from "the geopolitical situation in the Middle East and weather conditions until late summer, when new heatwaves could still occur."

headlines.title: 法国央行预计第三季度经济增长0.2%
headlines.summary: 【法国央行预计第三季度经济增长0.2%】当地时间8月11日，法国央行发布最新经济调查报告，预计法国今年第三季度国内生产总值（GDP）环比增长0.2%，与第二季度增速持平。法国央行表示，第三季度经济增长预计主要受到市场服务业活动支撑。7月份，法国工业和市场服务业活动继续增长，建筑业活动总体保持稳定。

headlines.title_en: French central bank expects Q3 GDP growth of 0.2%
headlines.summary_en: [France's central bank expects 0.2% Q3 economic growth] On August 11, the Bank of France released its latest economic survey, projecting GDP growth of 0.2% quarter-on-quarter in Q3, unchanged from Q2. Growth is expected to be mainly supported by market services activity. In July, industry and market services continued to grow, while construction activity remained broadly stable.

headlines.summary:

headlines.title: 央行逆回购再现“零操作”，分析称债市调整多出于止盈需求
headlines.summary: 央行逆回购再现“零操作”。8月11日，央行未开展7天期逆回购操作，当日有465亿元逆回购到期，公开市场实现净回笼465亿元。8月11日，资金面总体平稳，债市则在前期连续走强后震荡回调。受访人士认为，此次逆回购“零操作”主要缘于月初流动性充裕、金融机构融资需求下降。债市调整更多来自收益率快速下行后的止盈需求。随着税期临近、政府债券发行提速，加之超长债交易趋于拥挤，债券市场短期内仍将有所波动。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: PBOC's reverse repos see 'zero operation' again; analysts say bond market correction mostly driven by profit-taking
headlines.summary_en: PBOC conducted zero reverse repos again. On August 11, the central bank did not conduct 7-day reverse repo operations, with 46.5 billion yuan of reverse repos maturing that day, resulting in a net withdrawal of 46.5 billion yuan from the open market. Funding conditions were broadly stable, while the bond market pulled back after recent gains. Sources said the zero reverse repo reflects ample liquidity at the start of the month and lower financing demand from financial institutions. The bond market correction is more due to profit-taking after rapid yield declines. With tax season approaching, faster government bond issuance, and crowded ultra-long bond trading, bond market volatility is likely to persist in the near term. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 巴克莱：美债对价格敏感型买家的依赖显著上升，料使收益率维持高位
headlines.summary: 巴克莱表示，美国国债买家结构正在转向更注重价值的共同基金、家庭和其他私人投资者，这一变化帮助推动30年期美债收益率升至数十年来高位。策略师Demi Hu和Anshul Pradan认为，只要通胀持续存在，这些买家就会要求越来越高的补偿，才愿意持有长期债券。“美国国债的买家基础已经发生变化。”自2022年美联储开始缩减持仓以来，外国央行和美联储等官方部门的需求持续减弱，使得“私人投资者成为吸收新增供应的边际买家”。

headlines.title_en: Barclays: US Treasury reliance on price-sensitive buyers rises notably, likely to keep yields elevated
headlines.summary_en: Barclays says the buyer base of US Treasuries is shifting toward more value-focused mutual funds, households, and other private investors, a change that has helped push 30-year yields to multi-decade highs. Strategists Demi Hu and Anshul Pradan argue that as long as inflation persists, these buyers will demand increasingly higher compensation to hold long-dated bonds. "The buyer base of US Treasuries has changed." Since the Fed began shrinking its holdings in 2022, demand from official sectors such as foreign central banks and the Fed has weakened, making "private investors the marginal buyers absorbing new supply."

headlines.title: 美国两年期国债收益率跌超2个基点
headlines.summary: 周二（8月11日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期国债收益率跌1.63个基点，报4.6904%，北京时间18:00-21:46持续走低，从4.73%附近下挫至4.6659%刷新日低。 两年期美债收益率跌2.10个基点，报4.22%；30年期美债收益率跌0.86个基点，报5.2424%。 2/10年期美债收益率利差涨0.479个基点，报+46.826个基点。 10年期通胀保值国债（TIPS）收益率跌0.27个基点，至2.4274%；两年期TIPS收益率涨0.18个基点，至2.0357%；30年期TIPS收益率跌0.13个基点，至3.0183%。

headlines.title_en: US 2-year Treasury yield falls more than 2 basis points
headlines.summary_en: Tuesday (August 11) New York close: US 10-year Treasury yield fell 1.63 basis points to 4.6904%, declining steadily from 18:00-21:46 Beijing time, dropping from around 4.73% to a session low of 4.6659%. Two-year yield fell 2.10 basis points to 4.22%; 30-year yield fell 0.86 basis points to 5.2424%. 2/10 spread widened 0.479 basis points to +46.826 basis points. 10-year TIPS yield fell 0.27 basis points to 2.4274%; 2-year TIPS yield rose 0.18 basis points to 2.0357%; 30-year TIPS yield fell 0.13 basis points to 3.0183%.

headlines.title: 财达证券研究所“引援”再下一城，解运亮出任首席经济学家
headlines.summary: 法国央行表示，在重点行业增长和通胀降温支撑下，法国经济本季度有望保持增长势头。法国央行周二援引月度企业调查称，预计第三季度GDP将增长0.2%。这将与前一季度持平，略高于彭博调查分析师预计的0.1%。 法国央行表示，经济活动将继续由包括交通运输、信息和通信在内的服务业带动，而制造业在8月出现反弹。展望未来，能源行业预计将扩张，但由于公共合同减少，建筑业可能进一步下滑。与此同时，法国央行警告称，经济仍面临“重大不确定性”，原因包括“中东地缘政治局势以及直至夏末的天气状况，届时仍可能出现新的热浪”。

headlines.title: 央企“瘦身健体”改革攻坚提速，上市公司产权优化与总部架构重塑同步推进
headlines.summary: 央企控股上市公司股份无偿划转近期再添新案例。8月初，华电新能控股股东华电福瑞与母公司中国华电集团签署协议，将所持29%股份无偿划转至集团总部，华电新能产权层级由三级提升至二级。据统计，2026年已披露及正在推进的央企控股上市公司股权无偿划转案例已超过10起。

headlines.title_en: Central SOE 'slimming and fitness' reform accelerates; listed company equity optimization and headquarters restructuring advance in tandem
headlines.summary_en: Central state-owned enterprise (CSOEs) listed subsidiaries have seen new cases of free share transfers. In early August, Huadian New Energy's controlling shareholder Huadian Furu signed an agreement with parent China Huadian Group to transfer 29% of shares to the group headquarters free of charge, raising Huadian New Energy's ownership tier from three to two. As of 2026, more than 10 free share transfer cases involving CSOE-listed subsidiaries have been disclosed or are underway.
